### Mastercard to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


October 28, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_news/Mastercard-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-207d39cf4-2026.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) today announced its participation in the following investor conferences in November:


On Monday, November 9, Ed McLaughlin, president and chief technology officer, will present at Citi’s 15th Annual FinTech Conference in New York. The discussion will begin at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 35 minutes.


On Tuesday, November 10, Linda Kirkpatrick, chief services officer, will present at KBW’s 2026 Fintech Ecosystem Conference in New York. The discussion will begin at 3:25 p.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 40 minutes.


There will be a live audio webcast of the discussions and replay will be archived for 30 days at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54629554&newsitemid=20261027368161&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=d0c279f47148c67be1100de7480ec9cd) .


**About Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA),**[www.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mastercard.com&esheet=54629554&newsitemid=20261027368161&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mastercard.com&index=2&md5=6356269d783f9b6eeeb07a4cec367131) **** Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re building a resilient economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
